content.subheading: Coding with purpose, and blogging about it.

title.sub: Articles on software engineering and web development to share my knowledge and experience with others. I hope that my articles will help others learn and grow as developers, and that they will inspire others to share their own knowledge and experience.

list.title: How to Use Bash to Count Files: A Complete Guide
list.subheading: Counting Files in Bash Using Simple and Efficient Commands
list.excerpt: Learn how to efficiently count files in a directory using Bash. This guide covers different methods, including `find`, `ls`, and `wc`, with practical examples for accurate file counting in Linux and macOS.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Web Server Log Analyzer Script: A Complete Guide
list.subheading: Analyzing Web Server Logs with Bash for Insights
list.excerpt: Learn how to analyze web server logs using a Bash script. This guide walks you through processing access logs to extract meaningful data, such as unique IP counts, request patterns, and traffic insights.

list.title: Leveraging Decorators and Metadata in Node.js with TypeScript
list.subheading: Enhancing API Development Through Reflective Metadata and Decorators
list.excerpt: Dive into an advanced Node.js implementation using TypeScript, where decorators and reflective metadata streamline API development. Learn how to bind HTTP routes to class methods for a clean and efficient server setup.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Unraveling the Contains Duplicate Challenge: Crafting Optimized Solutions in JavaScript
list.subheading: Explore Multiple Approaches to a Classic Coding Problem, Enhancing Your Problem-Solving Skills and JavaScript Mastery
list.excerpt: Dive into various JavaScript solutions to the popular 'Contains Duplicate' coding challenge, exploring distinct approaches, and learning how to leverage their unique attributes and complexities for optimized web development application. Enrich your problem-solving toolkit with strategic insights applicable across diverse coding challenges and web-development projects.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Mastering the 3Sum Algorithm in JavaScript

list.author: Paul Serban
